classic.content: axiom classic : ∀ P : Prop, P ∨ ¬ P

sUnion.content: def sUnion (A B : X → Prop) : X → Prop := fun x => A x ∨ B x

sInter.content: def sInter (A B : X → Prop) : X → Prop := fun x => A x ∧ B x

sCompl.content: def sCompl (A : X → Prop) : X → Prop := fun x => ¬ A x

inter_distrib_left.content:
theorem inter_distrib_left (A B C : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, (A ∩s (B ∪s C)) x ↔ ((A ∩s B) ∪s (A ∩s C)) x :=
by
  intro x; constructor
  · intro h; rcases h with ⟨hA, hBC⟩; cases hBC with
    | inl hB => exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hB⟩
    | inr hC => exact Or.inr ⟨hA, hC⟩
  · intro h; cases h with
    | inl hAB => exact ⟨hAB.1, Or.inl hAB.2⟩
    | inr hAC => exact ⟨hAC.1, Or.inr hAC.2⟩

inter_distrib_right.content:
theorem inter_distrib_right (A B C : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, ((A ∪s B) ∩s C) x ↔ ((A ∩s C) ∪s (B ∩s C)) x :=
by
  intro x; constructor
  · intro h; rcases h with ⟨hAB, hC⟩; cases hAB with
    | inl hA => exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hC⟩
    | inr hB => exact Or.inr ⟨hB, hC⟩
  · intro h; cases h with
    | inl hAC => exact ⟨Or.inl hAC.1, hAC.2⟩
    | inr hBC => exact ⟨Or.inr hBC.1, hBC.2⟩

de_morgan_union.content:
theorem de_morgan_union (A B : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, (ᶜs (A ∪s B)) x ↔ (ᶜs A ∩s ᶜs B) x :=
by
  intro x; constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨fun hA => h (Or.inl hA), fun hB => h (Or.inr hB)⟩
  · intro h; intro hAB; cases h with
    | intro hA hB => cases hAB with
      | inl hA' => exact (hA hA')
      | inr hB' => exact (hB hB')

de_morgan_inter.content:
theorem de_morgan_inter (A B : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, (ᶜs (A ∩s B)) x ↔ (ᶜs A ∪s ᶜs B) x :=
by
  intro x; constructor
  · intro h
    cases classic (A x) with
    | inl hA =>
        right; intro hB; exact h ⟨hA, hB⟩
    | inr hA =>
        left; exact hA
  · intro h; intro hAB; cases hAB with
    | intro hA hB => cases h with
      | inl hA' => exact hA' hA
      | inr hB' => exact hB' hB

sUnion.content: Definition sUnion (A B : X -> Prop) : X -> Prop := fun x => A x \/ B x.

sInter.content: Definition sInter (A B : X -> Prop) : X -> Prop := fun x => A x /\ B x.

sCompl.content: Definition sCompl (A : X -> Prop) : X -> Prop := fun x => ~ A x.

inter_distrib_left.content:
Lemma inter_distrib_left (A B C : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sInter A (sUnion B C)) x <-> (sUnion (sInter A B) (sInter A C)) x.
  Proof.
    intro x; split; intros H.
    - destruct H as [HA [HB|HC]]; [left|right]; split; assumption.
    - destruct H as [[HA HB]|[HA HC]]; split; try assumption; [left|right]; assumption.
  Qed.

inter_distrib_right.content:
Lemma inter_distrib_right (A B C : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sInter (sUnion A B) C) x <-> (sUnion (sInter A C) (sInter B C)) x.
  Proof.
    intro x; split; intros H.
    - destruct H as [[HA|HB] HC]; [left|right]; split; assumption.
    - destruct H as [[HA HC]|[HB HC]]; split; try assumption; [left|right]; assumption.
  Qed.

de_morgan_union.content:
Lemma de_morgan_union (A B : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sCompl (sUnion A B)) x <-> (sInter (sCompl A) (sCompl B)) x.
  Proof.
    intro x; split; intros H.
    - split; intro H'; apply H; [left|right]; assumption.
    - intros [HA|HB]; destruct H as [H1 H2]; [apply H1|apply H2]; assumption.
  Qed.

de_morgan_inter.content:
Lemma de_morgan_inter (A B : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sCompl (sInter A B)) x <-> (sUnion (sCompl A) (sCompl B)) x.
  Proof.
    intro x; split; intros H.
    - destruct (classic (A x)) as [HA|HnA].
      + right; intro HB; apply H; split; assumption.
      + left; exact HnA.
    - intros [HA HB]; destruct H as [HnA|HnB]; [apply HnA in HA|apply HnB in HB]; contradiction.
  Qed.
